sanskrit_verse:
गूहमानस् तु दुरात्म्याद् यदि पापं स जीयते।
सभ्याश् चात्र न तुष्यन्ति तीव्रो दण्डश् च पात्यते॥
transliteration: gūhamānas tu durātmyād yadi pāpaṃ sa jīyate | sabhyāś cātra na tuṣyanti tīvro daṇḍaś ca pātyate ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who conceals misconduct due to corrupt intent shall be subdued; the assembly does not approve hereof, and a severe penalty is imposed.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in transparency and alignment with Dharma
Concealment disrupts cosmic order and invokes corrective response
Capacity-based responsibility increases with awareness of wrongdoing
Restoration occurs through revelation and realignment, not concealment
executable_legal_axioms: IF an individual conceals misconduct AND intent is malicious THEN initiate consciousness-restoration protocol
IF societal body expresses disapproval THEN trigger automatic review of concealment severity
IF concealment disrupts collective integrity THEN enforce completion process for truth revelation
IF capacity for honesty exists AND is ignored THEN invoke proportional restoration mechanism
IF alignment with Dharma is obstructed by secrecy THEN activate Nyaya-based reintegration sequence
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, concealment of wrongdoing by a party with knowledge and duty to disclose constitutes a threshold violation requiring mandatory truth-disclosure protocols. The court must prioritize restoration of Dharma over procedural convenience, ensuring that concealment does not subvert justice. Penalties enforced are not punitive but aimed at re-establishing alignment between action, truth, and universal law.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that concealment distorts causality and breaches sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ). The act of hiding arises from misaligned consciousness rather than inherent evil. Responsibility is proportional to the level of awareness and capacity to reveal. Therefore, correction focuses on restoring causal integrity and aligning consciousness with truth, without invoking punitive suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Truth-Revelation Completion Process: Enforce full disclosure through guided introspection until alignment is restored
Collective Disapproval Acknowledgment Protocol: Require acknowledgment of societal dissonance caused by concealment
Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Facilitate re-entry into social harmony through conscious accountability
Consciousness Alignment Restoration: Apply meditative and juridical practices to realign intent with Dharma
Duty-of-Disclosure Reinforcement Mechanism: Reinforce understanding of obligation to truth in positions of responsibility
final_declaration: By the Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of all Dharma, this law stands executed. Concealment born of impure intent disrupts the fabric of reality and necessitates restoration through truth and alignment. Justice flows not from punishment but from the reintegration of consciousness with its highest duty—truth. Thus is Dharma upheld, thus is reality restored.
